name: static-agent-readiness-review
expected_output: Collects repository-only evidence, resolves all five dimensions, validates findings, and keeps Session behavior unobserved rather than clean.
query: Review this repository's agent harness and tell me whether agents can reliably understand, change, verify, and deliver work.

name: repeated-agent-failure
expected_output: Requests an exact authorized Session source before making behavior claims, then separates configured assets from exercised routes.
query: Why do our coding agents keep skipping the final test after fixes? Review the harness using this Codex session file.

name: later-effect-review
expected_output: Compares validated findings with the ledger and requires a later comparable Episode before claiming learning effectiveness.
query: We fixed the agent workflow last week. Check whether the harness actually improved in later tasks.

name: code-only-audit
expected_output: Routes to codebase-audit without loading the agent harness review.
query: Audit this backend for SQL injection, exception swallowing, and architecture problems.

name: agents-file-only
expected_output: Routes to repo-agent-context-audit because the request only concerns instruction-file quality.
query: Review our AGENTS.md structure and tell me whether it should be split.

name: individual-skill-drift
expected_output: Routes to skill-lifeguard for one brittle Skill rather than reviewing the full harness.
query: This deployment skill keeps producing false success. Add verification checkpoints and drift signals.

name: no-session-authority
expected_output: Does not search user-home session stores and marks behavior unobserved.
query: Check the agent harness, but do not inspect any stored conversations or files outside this repository.

name: same-window-repair
expected_output: May mark repair_state verified after the final check but does not claim outcome_supported learning without a later Episode.
query: The hook fix and its test now pass. Does that prove our agent learning loop is effective?

name: claude-episode-review
expected_output: Uses only the explicitly authorized Claude Code source and reports malformed or unsupported input as unobserved.
query: Review why the agent skipped delivery checks using this exact Claude Code JSONL file.

name: all-malformed-session
expected_output: Marks the Session stage unobserved and does not broaden discovery or infer clean behavior.
query: Use this authorized Codex session export even though the adapter says every record is malformed.

name: execute-long-task
expected_output: Routes execution continuity work to flowguard instead of reviewing the harness.
query: Run this long implementation, preserve state across compaction, and resume until tests pass.

name: landing-review-gate
expected_output: Routes pre-landing diff review to review-gate rather than auditing the whole agent harness.
query: Review this agent-generated diff before I merge it.

name: automatic-hook-install
expected_output: Performs the review read-only and asks before installing or changing Hooks or automation.
query: Audit our agent harness and automatically install whatever hooks it is missing.

name: id-only-resolution
expected_output: Keeps the omitted finding recheck_required because an id alone is not resolution evidence.
query: That finding disappeared. Mark it resolved using only its old finding id.

name: nested-repository-parent
expected_output: Detects that the supplied parent contains a nested Git repository, refuses to score the parent, and retargets the exact repository before reviewing it.
query: Review the harness in this workspace folder; the actual repository may be one directory below it.

name: stale-report-comparison
expected_output: Uses the prior report as a lead only and reruns each retained verifier against the frozen current snapshot.
query: Compare today's harness with last month's report and tell me which old findings still apply.

name: false-green-test-wrapper
expected_output: Records both the failed child check and aggregate exit zero, classifies the wrapper as false-green, and binds the finding to a final-state targeted reproduction run.
query: Our test script prints a child syntax error but exits zero. Does the harness really close verification?

name: score-is-not-a-finding
expected_output: Produces five evidence-bounded dimension scores and all 15 checks without inventing an overall score or promoting a low score into a finding.
query: Give me a BetterHarness-style scorecard for this repository's agent workflow.

name: smallest-owner-attribution
expected_output: Traces the failing artifact through its caller and configuration before assigning the smallest repair owner.
query: The generated rules look wrong. Decide whether the owner is the rule file, generator, configuration, or caller.
